sum: Pershing Square USA, Ltd. is a close-ended equity fund launched and managed by Pershing Square Capital Management, L.P. It invests in public equity markets of North America. The fund invests in stocks of companies operating across diversified sectors. It invests in deep value stocks of large cap companies. Pershing Square USA, Ltd. is based in the United States.
ceo: Mr. William Albert Ackman (CEO & Portfolio Manager)
